SELECT po.payment_obligation_id AS paymentObligationId, po.participant_id AS participantId, po.expected_amount AS expectedAmount,
COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS paidAmount,
po.expected_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS remainingAmount,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) = 0 THEN 'UNPAID' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) < po.expected_amount THEN 'PARTIALLY_PAID' ELSE 'PAID' END AS paymentStatus
FROM payment_obligation po
JOIN settlement_participant sp ON sp.participant_id = po.participant_id
JOIN settlement_invitation si ON si.invitation_id = sp.invitation_id
JOIN settlement s ON s.settlement_id = si.settlement_id
LEFT JOIN payment_record pr ON pr.payment_target_type = 'SETTLEMENT' AND pr.target_id = po.payment_obligation_id AND pr.record_status = 'CONFIRMED'
WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND po.obligation_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY po.payment_obligation_id, po.participant_id, po.expected_amount ORDER BY po.payment_obligation_id
